verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the Edison Scientific documentation with links to .md pages. The docs also serve Markdown versions of pages that explicitly point agents to the llms.txt index, and the docs corpus is published at .md URLs throughout. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent bundle, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively.
